usedFor: Vyte holds booked appointments, and MailerLite adds the customer as a subscriber through “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Event Is Confirmed” in Vyte, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A confirmed Vyte booking adds the customer to MailerLite, with no duplicate if they exist.

watchOut: “Event Is Updated” fires on every change, so one booking can reach MailerLite more than once.
